entry.name: rnbo_unjoin
entry.description: Break a list into smaller lists or individual elements.

arguments.name: outlets
arguments.digest: Number of outlets (items to break the list into)
arguments.description: Sets the number of outlets to add to the object. Each outlet will output a list of up to the length of.

arguments.name: outsize
arguments.description: Sets the list length for the output lists. All outlets will output a list of up to this size based on the length of the input list. If there are too few elements, a smaller list will be output. If there are any extra elements, they will be output as a single list from the rightmost outlet (the 'Extra' outlet).
